newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers soft, 1-2 majors out of supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers soft, 1-2 majors out of supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were a shade weaker as offers moved lower in anticipation of weaker cargo quotes, traders said on Wednesday.
Bunker 180-cst were quoted at $102 and 380-cst at $96 a tonne. A major said enquiries were healthy but some majors have already sold out of bunker fuel until February 15.
"The market has started to wind down ahead of the Lunar New Year holidays," said a trader.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $90 and $197-$201 respectively.
